Both changes are saved and the API accepted them. I read them back to confirm.

- **Main colour:** `theme.assistedModeColors.primary` is now `#1B5E20`, a dark green. The portal is in assisted mode, so this is the field that drives the main colour. The `theme.colors.primary` value is still `#1976D2` in the stored document. The portal recalculates the palettes when a draft is saved in the editor, so that value should update then. I did not edit the palettes by hand, since assisted mode would overwrite those edits anyway. If the editor does not recalculate on its own, tell me and I'll set the palette values directly.
- **Menu:** I added "Nos actions pour la jeunesse" (page `jeunesse`) as a "Page libre" entry at the end of the menu, after Home and Catalogue de données. Its label is taken from the page title. If you want it in a different position or with a shorter label, I can change that.
